summary: A new EFB home screen: a flight tracking widget with the aircraft's photo, departure and arrival clocks, and apps and widgets you can put anywhere.
releaseNotes: Flight tracking widget: the aircraft's photo by registration, callsign, route, scheduled and estimated times, progress, altitude, speed and phase.
Departure and arrival clock widgets with each airport's local time from your SimBrief plan.
Hold the home screen to edit it: drag apps and widgets anywhere, move apps in and out of the dock, and add or remove widgets.
Re-import your SimBrief plan once so the airport clocks can show local time.
